statement: Chandra-Mangala Yoga (Moon and Mars sharing a sign) is traditionally read as carrying entrepreneurial energy and business acumen — financial gain through one's own initiative, though classically noted to run 'hot' (impulsive, argumentative) without a tempering influence.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard Vedic astrological literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
